metadata.purpose: post-diagnostic locked confirmation of revised MA/volume rules
metadata.execution: signal at close; execute at next trading-day open
limitations: The confirmation set is deliberately adverse and not a representative market portfolio.
The same securities may appear in development at earlier dates; only their 2024+ outcomes are held out.
Historical accuracy cannot guarantee future realized returns.
Daily bars cannot establish intraday order path or queue position.

paired_buy.selection_basis: maximize the worst-case train/validation score before reading confirmation

directional_sell.selection_basis: maximize the worst-case train/validation direction score before reading confirmation
